blocks.text: Decades of Metal Supply Solutions Experience | 1972 – 2025

T.I. is the global leader in specialty metals & titanium supply for the Aerospace, Defense, Industrial, Medical and Oil & Gas markets. Holding the world’s most complete inventory of Titanium Round & Rectangle Bar, Titanium Plate, Titanium Sheet, Titanium Pipe & Fittings and other specialty metals across a global service center network, T.I. delivers supply solutions at all levels of sophistication and complexity. With a globally experienced and technically driven team, T.I. has been providing dependable, quality driven service to our customers since 1972.

blocks.text: Titanium Industries offers a wide variety of specialty metal processing capabilities with the objective of reducing costs and cycle times. Uniquely positioned as a privately owned, financially sound, and nimble partner with strategically placed service centers, Titanium Industries is prepared to invest in value-producing infrastructure with our client's needs at the forefront.

T.I. has been providing the world with specialty metals and titanium products since 1972. We maintain a complete inventory of specialty metals and titanium mill products, offering a wide variety of grades and sizes with lead times to satisfy your manufacturing needs. T.I. is the global leader in specialty metals supply for the following markets.

blocks.text: As your foremost Global Metal Supplier, Titanium Industries stands as your most trusted partner in the industry. With over 50 years of experience, we specialize in providing specialty metals and solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, Industrial, Medical, and Oil & Gas markets. Holding the world’s most complete inventory of Titanium Round & Rectangle Bar, Plate, Sheet, Pipe & Fittings, and other specialty metals across a global service center network, T.I. delivers supply solutions at all levels of sophistication and complexity. With a globally experienced and technically driven team, T.I. has been providing dependable, quality-driven service to our customers since 1972. Trust Titanium Industries as your go-to Global Metal Supplier for all your metal supply needs.
